module_summary: Direct-mapped write-through cache: FSM latches CPU request, checks tag/valid arrays, refills or writes memory, then responds.

anchors.name: n2_409
anchors.why: IDLE/LOOKUP/WRITE_MEM/REFILL/RESPOND controller; drives handshakes, memory requests, array writes.

anchors.name: n20_98b
anchors.why: Tag array per line; written on refill, compared for hit.

anchors.name: n24_3c0
anchors.why: Data array per line; filled on refill, updated on write hit.

anchors.name: n12_4c5
anchors.why: Per-line valid bits, set on refill, qualify hit.

anchors.name: n13_d16
anchors.why: Hit flag: valid and tag match; chooses respond vs refill, gates write update.

anchors.name: n9_f13
anchors.why: Latched request address; supplies index, tag and memory address.

anchors.name: n4_b56
anchors.why: Latched write data sent to memory and written into data array.

anchors.name: n10_3a8
anchors.why: Latched write flag steering LOOKUP to WRITE_MEM path.

anchors.name: n25_e09
anchors.why: Line index from address; addresses tag, data and valid arrays.

anchors.name: n1_a1c
anchors.why: Tag field of latched address, compared and stored on refill.

anchors.name: n18_89b
anchors.why: Response data register: hit data, refill data or write data.

anchors.name: n26_cbf
anchors.why: CPU request valid; starts lookup and latches request.

anchors.name: n7_900
anchors.why: CPU request ready, high in IDLE.

anchors.name: n27_191
anchors.why: CPU write/read select captured with request.

anchors.name: n22_f8a
anchors.why: CPU request address.

anchors.name: n19_bec
anchors.why: CPU write data.

anchors.name: n14_dbe
anchors.why: CPU response valid pulse in RESPOND state.

anchors.name: n8_706
anchors.why: CPU read response data from response register.

anchors.name: n3_29e
anchors.why: Busy status while lookup or memory access in progress.

anchors.name: n6_c12
anchors.why: Memory request valid during REFILL or WRITE_MEM.

anchors.name: n23_d3a
anchors.why: Memory write enable during WRITE_MEM.

anchors.name: n21_c8f
anchors.why: Memory address from latched request address.

anchors.name: n16_bc2
anchors.why: Memory write data from latched write data.

anchors.name: n15_9fe
anchors.why: Memory acknowledge; completes refill or write, triggers array updates.

anchors.name: n0_1cf
anchors.why: Memory read data used for refill and response.

groups.name: cache_fsm
groups.description: Request sequencer choosing hit response, refill or write-through memory access.

groups.name: cache_arrays
groups.description: Tag, data and valid arrays indexed by line index.

groups.name: hit_compare
groups.description: Splits address into index/tag, compares stored tag with valid bit.

groups.name: request_latch
groups.description: Captures CPU address and write data at request acceptance.

groups.name: response_path
groups.description: Selects response data from hit, refill, or written data.

groups.name: cpu_port
groups.description: CPU request/response handshake with address and data.

groups.name: mem_port
groups.description: Backing memory request/ack bus for refills and write-through.
